name: a refused rules file is told as a board that cannot be used
find: raise DesignError("%s", refused, code=design_codes.RULES_REFUSED) from refused
replace: raise DesignError("%s", refused, code=design_codes.BOARD_UNUSABLE) from refused

name: a named strapping pin is told as a pin another signal holds
a part with no pin_order is told as a part with no footprint
a board that lacks its footprint facts is told as a board that disagrees with itself
a refused input at the schematic stage loses its error's code
find: raise RefusedInput(SCHEMATIC_STAGE, str(broken), broken.code) from broken
replace: raise RefusedInput(SCHEMATIC_STAGE, str(broken), design_codes.REQUIREMENTS_FIELD_WRONG) from broken

name: a board that cannot be loaded is a plain str again, with no code
find: return None, None, Refusal("no board or rules to generate from: %s" % exc, code)
replace: return None, None, "no board or rules to generate from: %s" % exc
